purpose: S81 Engram MIX4 arithmetic leaf ot_s81_engram_add8 on v21 die-tool pins

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_engram_add8 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_f12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_fp32_add_l6.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_add6.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_norm.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fpu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp_lat_f12.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_fsqrt.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_fdiv.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_softplus.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_sfu.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_actquant.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_aq12.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_divc.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_vec_side.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/engram/mix/ot_s81_engram_mix.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81engm_add8/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81engm_add8/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81engm_add8 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_engram_add8  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Engram MIX4 physical hierarchy (S-ELEM-C 2026-10-15): every arithmetic root of ot_s81_engram_mix is a hardened leaf master, hardened once and replicated; inputs registered at the S pins, outputs launched from registers at the N pins (no added cycle: the leaves are the unchanged exact arithmetic RTL).
